environment.rendering: nested labwc headless, pixman/Cairo, software WebKit

baseline: Phase 1 working-tree snapshot, before lazy applications and ESM splitting; sequential fixture run

boundaries.shell: shell process and descendants, including WebKit/sandbox helpers
boundaries.desktop_stack: selected compositor and shell trees; background services outside these trees excluded
boundaries.baseline_stack: not measured separately; baseline stack fields duplicate shell only and must not be compared as stack totals
boundaries.timing: The existing initial gate waits for dock, top bar and already-created menus. Menu sets differ between versions; timings are not a controlled startup comparison and exclude wallpaper readiness/first paint.

notes: Single before/after observation, not statistical qualification.
CPU samples span about two seconds, insufficient to qualify idle CPU target.
Shared JavaScript source does not share renderer heaps across isolated WebKit processes.
